newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Mar first 10 days trade surplus falls yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Mar first 10 days trade surplus falls yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus fell 61.0 percent to 142.09 billion yen in the first 10 days of March from a revised surplus of 364.62 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Wednesday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 6.4 percent from a year earlier to 1.27 trillion yen while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 36.2 percent to 1.13 trillion yen.
